title: Normalized scalar presentations and multiplication unitors
statement: Let X be a scheme with an essentially small small pro-etale site, and suppose the module categories of all coefficient ring sheaves have the specified unbounded derived categories. There exists a simultaneous family p_alpha of universal ordinary and derived scalar-extension presentations for all ring maps alpha, with a normalized composition datum of [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization]. For every coefficient ring R, its identity-map presentation admits UnitData(p,R) in the sense of [def-pur-ordinary-line-scalar-data]: the ordinary unitor sends s tensor x to sx, and its derived unitor on Q(P) is the fixed scalar computation map followed by Q of degreewise multiplication. The ordinary and derived functors, computation maps and normalization equations are exactly those recorded in the cited definitions.

proof.text: Use successive_derived_quotient_normalization to obtain the universal scalar presentations and their tower normalization.

For identity coefficients, adjoint uniqueness identifies ordinary scalar extension with the identity. The adjunction unit and scalar linearity give multiplication s tensor x maps to sx. Universal left-derived uniqueness localizes this unitor, and quotient comparison naturality proves its specified cochain computation formula.
